newsitem.title: USA: IHOP trims yr's new restaurant openings.
newsitem.headline: IHOP trims yr's new restaurant openings.

text.p: IHOP Corp said Thursday that its plans for new restaurant openings for this year have been modified and are now expected to number between 65 and 70 restaurants rather than 75 to 80 as previously expected.

The company cited intense competition for the limited number of restaurant locations that are available at fair value as the primary reason for the revised forecast. Included in the expected 1996 openings are 45 to 50 restaurants developed by the company and about 20 by IHOP's franchisees and area licensees.

IH0P Corp. opened 19 restaurants in the third quarter ended September 30, 1996, bringing the total restaurants year-to-date to 42. During the quarter IHOP franchised 17 restaurants, of which 16 were developed by the company and one by a franchisee.
